answer: Sponsor liability makes every new key cost its inviter. A sponsor signs a velvet ticket, single use, expiring in 10 epochs, and locks a 100 POA ferrous bond behind each invitee. The sponsor is the vertex of its invitee tree, so one flagged duplicate-controller leaf puts the whole tree up for audit and forfeits that leaf's bond. A farm of 1,000 fakes locks 1,000 x 100 POA = 100,000 POA, and if audits flag 10% of them it forfeits 100 x 100 POA. Attacker pays 10,000 POA.
